title: Probing the staying power of chemogenetics
abstract: A study that monitored the expression and function of designer receptors called DREADDs in macaque monkeys for a period of three years demonstrates that they are effective in long-term studies of nonhuman primates.

affiliations.institution: Decision and Awareness Group, Cognitive Neuroscience Laboratory, German Primate Center – Leibniz Institute for Primate Research
